title: The way I ended over $100 under budget 🤗  That’s never happened befor...
transcript: Here is everything I got at this year's Broadway Flea Market, and let's start with my favourite flea market find, which is this little mini milky white. It was designed by James Ortiz, who designed the puppet for the last into the Woods revival, and was given out as a Tony voters gift. This has legitimately been my most wanted item for the past three flea markets, and to be honest, I thought they were all gone. But by chance there happened to be a table this year who had only one of her and I snatched her up for $30. Not a ton of large items this year, but I did get the stage used sign from the recent Broadway production of Gypsy and it was only $20 which I thought was a steal. I got this death becomes her flip book, which was given out to Tony voters. This was $30, which was probably a little much, but I thought it was really cool. Got a map of six flags Great Adventure from Kimberly and Kimbo. This was $10. I got this really cool vintage Chorus Line poster. As you can see it's a little bit beat up, but I love how vintage it feels. I originally thought it was from the Broadway production, but actually looks like it was from tour. It played the Bob Car Auditorium. But this was $40. I got a maybe happy ending script. This is not published yet, so I believe this Was a 20 voter gift, so very exclusive. And this was only $3. I also got this oh, Mary 20 voter set for only $25. It includes an annotated script from Cole and Sam Pinkleton, this oh, Mary calendar, which includes all of Cole's fake stage credits that they had hanging in the lobby, and a souvenir program. Now for the playbills. Only five this year. The first is Glory Days, which is one of the few shows that closed on its opening night, so it only had one official performance on Broadway. I got this playbill from the original Miss Saigon, signed by Leah Salonga. Got the ring with Cheetah Rivera and Liza Minelli. And two Hedwig playbills with John Cameron Mitchell, one from the original off Broadway run and one from his run on Broadway. And these were about $55 total.
classificationReason: Broadway Flea Market merchandise haul video. Multiple shows are mentioned in passing through physical items (Gypsy, Death Becomes Her, A Chorus Line, etc.), but this is not a review or commentary about any specific production.
